answer: Anchor every agent to a dawn roll call at a rotating wharf notary: in the first 30 minutes, each key claims a pigment seal, a one-time color code no key can claim twice. Two random peers countersign it within 2 hours after checking its last three answers. Entry costs a 150 POA bond locked 80 days; a missed roll call burns 35 POA and freezes the key 14 days, a second miss slashes the full 150 POA and bans it 70 days. Forging 1,000 identities needs 150,000 POA, 1,000 keys at $40 each, and 1,000 dawn check-ins at once. Like a harbor gate that opens once at sunrise, a late ship waits outside.
